name: Suse Yuika
source: Ritsuka's sister, a member of the church well-known in town as a pious nun. Virtually blind because of a genetic condition but her other senses compensate for her disability to the point she is hardly inconvenienced by her poor sight. Capable of acts of violence when angered.
